purchasePathNote: Buyers reserve NEO on the 1X order page with a $200 fully refundable deposit, then choose $20,000 Early Access ownership or a $499 per month subscription. 1X says US deliveries start in 2026, with international expansion from 2027.

configurations.name: NEO Early Access (ownership)
configurations.notes: Includes 3-year warranty, premium support and priority delivery. $200 refundable deposit due at order. Charger, lint roller and case included.

configurations.name: NEO Standard (subscription, per month)
configurations.notes: Price is per month. Includes a Starter Productivity Package and standard delivery, which comes after Early Access deliveries.

Official order page still lists $20,000 ownership and $499/month subscription

faq.a: You can preorder it. 1X takes a $200 fully refundable deposit on its order page and says US deliveries start in 2026.

faq.q: How much does the 1X NEO cost?
faq.a: $20,000 for Early Access ownership with a 3-year warranty, or $499 per month as a subscription.
1X says first shipments go to early adopters in the US in 2026, with international expansion starting in 2027. Subscribers get a later delivery date than Early Access buyers.

faq.q: Is NEO available outside the US?
faq.a: Not yet. 1X lists only US deliveries for 2026 and says international expansion starts in 2027.

faq.q: How many NEOs have been ordered?
faq.a: 1X reported that first-year production capacity sold out within five days of preorders opening in October 2025.

notes: Preorder only; no independently verified customer delivery was found at check time. The $499 subscription is a monthly price, not a total. Taxes and delivery fees are not stated on the order page.
